description: This file defines interfaces related to asynchronous streaming in Orleans, including IAsyncStream<T> with methods for subscription management and core properties, and a non-generic IAsyncStream interface for stream metadata.

classes.name: IAsyncStream<T>
classes.description: Represents a distributed rendezvous stream with methods to retrieve subscription handles, and implements multiple observable and producer interfaces.

classes.name: IAsyncStream
classes.description: Represents core stream properties such as whether it is rewindable, its provider name, and its stream identifier.

methods.name: GetAllSubscriptionHandles
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all active subscription handles created by the caller for the stream.
